payload.summary: Post-GitHub Drive v27 training history records 3,785 examples including a 1,449-example seven-class recast, 4,261 rejected candidates, zero explicit tool calls in recast answers, and a later correction showing that `intent`/`hypothesis` were internal live markers rather than external registry tools. Blind evaluation initially read a growing file and had to freeze an explicit SHA. Runtime/source parity was treated as mandatory: dataset-only prompt cleanup was rejected as train-inference drift.
actions: ClayCode/FRANK: type-separate internal cognition markers, declarative tool descriptions and external effect authority; syntax alone must not define capability.
Harness: add false-positive validator, stale-registry, moving-heldout and train-inference mismatch tests.
Training-data lane: recover/hash v27 source datasets/scripts and use historical rejection rules only after mapping to current fixed Clay/Needle semantics.
UnifiedDB/ClayGraph: dataset/eval identity is content hash + generator state/epoch, not filename.
